author_or_org: Hayagriv Sridharan, Saurabh Sarkar, Parag Paul, Eugenie Cheng

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The paper proposes a hybrid ontology framework for semantic data understanding in AI-augmented data warehousing.
claims.quote: Toward a Hybrid Ontology Framework for Semantic Data Understanding in AI-Augmented Data Warehousing

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: The hybrid ontology framework integrates deterministic schema metadata with flexible semantic enrichment derived from documentation, ETL scripts, and business glossaries.
claims.quote: This work presents a hybrid ontology framework that integrates deterministic schema metadata with flexible semantic enrichment derived from documentation, ETL scripts, and business glossaries, and demonstrates improvements in entity disambiguation, catalog enrichment, and cross-system understanding.
